PensionFiling.title: Pension filing
PensionFiling.description: A UPA (Uniforme Pensioenaangifte) delivery to one sector pension fund for one wage period, reporting an approved PayrollRun (pension-filing-upa-mvp). The APG-administered funds are gated on the referenced payroll run being approved before the filing can progress past review — the verified Loket.nl/APG gating rule — via a declarative create->review->confirm->send lifecycle (concept -> gecontroleerd -> bevestigd -> verzonden) mirroring the loonaangifte filing flow.

controleren.description: Marks the filing as reviewed. PayrollRunApprovedGuard denies the transition unless the referenced PayrollRun's status is approved, posted or paid — an HR admin may still prepare a concept filing while the run is in review, but cannot progress it further until the run is approved.

bevestigen.description: Confirms the reviewed filing for dispatch to the fund.

verzenden.description: Marks the filing as sent. submittedDate and verzondenDoor are stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern).

heropenen.description: Reopens a not-yet-sent filing for correction before it is confirmed or sent.

corrigeren.description: A sent UPA delivery is superseded by a correction. The usual route is a corrected delivery for the same period; this transition's reset-to-concept semantics are a simplified placeholder for that correction workflow.

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: The approved payroll run this filing reports on.
payrollRunId.x-notes: Reference to the approved PayrollRun this UPA delivery reports on. Drives PayrollRunApprovedGuard on the controleren transition and the nl-upa-payrollrun-approved reference-integrity check.

period.title: Period
period.description: Wage period this delivery covers, in YYYY-MM.

fund.title: Fund
fund.description: Which sector pension fund this filing goes to.
fund.x-notes: The sector pension fund this delivery is addressed to. APG-administered funds first (nl-pensioenaangifte); other administrators extend this enum in data later.

aanleverkenmerk.title: Submission reference
aanleverkenmerk.description: The UPA delivery reference agreed or returned for this delivery.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: The fund's own deadline for this filing. Enter it yourself — unlike the tax filing, there is no single formula across funds.
deadline.x-notes: The fund's aanleverschema/uitvoeringsreglement deadline for this delivery. Authoritative input — unlike the loonaangifte, there is no single statutory derivation formula across funds, so this is not derived.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this filing has got to: draft, checked, confirmed or sent.
status.x-notes: UPA delivery lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gecontroleerd -> bevestigd -> verzonden).

responseStatus.title: Response status
responseStatus.description: What the fund sent back. Correct a rejected filing with the 'corrigeren' action.
responseStatus.x-notes: Outcome of the fund/APG response to a sent delivery. A rejected (afgekeurd) delivery is corrected via the corrigeren transition; no automated polling/ingestion happens in this app.

responseMessage.title: Response message
responseMessage.description: What the fund wrote back — a confirmation, or the reason for rejection.
responseMessage.x-notes: Free-text response message from the fund/APG (acceptance note or rejection reason).

submittedDate.title: Submitted date
submittedDate.x-notes: Date the delivery was sent, stamped on the verzenden carrying write.

verzondenDoor.title: Sent by
verzondenDoor.x-notes: Display name of the person who sent the delivery, stamped on the verzenden carrying write (the Timesheet approvedBy pattern).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this PensionFiling is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007) audits it against the referenced payrollRunId's PayrollRun.administrationId (the parent, the Payslip precedent).
